outcome: Land HMS Endeavour: hybrid Luikov inverse combining M9 surface-Dirichlet BC (proven best top BC) with M15 asymmetric-tin bottom BC + alpha(T) oven-spring profile. Tests whether stacking the proven-best BC choice with the additional physics layers identified in M11-M16 finally drops main-bake RMSE below 4 deg C. 5 free parameters: L, D, Lu, q_bottom_eff, alpha_ratio.
success_metric: Forward solver passes Dirichlet-BC sanity (constant surface temp gives expected steady-state). Synthetic recovery passes within 30 percent on at least 1 case. Real-CSV joint inverse converges on at least 5 of 7 fixtures with at least 3 of 5 parameters interior. Main-bake RMSE comparison vs M9 (5-11 deg C), M15 (6.1 deg C). LOO deep-end T1 test on 3 fixtures vs M15 baseline. If main-bake RMSE under 4 deg C verdict GO and we proceed to production wiring; otherwise the information limit is final across the full hierarchy of formulations.
